facts.fact: Kapitalis (analyst Ben Moussa) says Tunisia's National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCS) presented government circular 5/2026 on 4 September 2026, which requires public bodies to report incidents to it immediately, and that ANCS published a tender on 20 October 2026 for a vulnerability portal.

note: No incident handled or alert issued by ANCS, and no critical infrastructure designation, is stated; the vulnerability portal is only at tender.
